criteria.requirement: Add opt-in keyword-only strict=False to ConfigBox bool/int/float/list and numeric/boolean aliases. Preserve default loose casting, distinguish omitted defaults from explicit default=None, and do not confuse an existing empty value with missing. Strict booleans accept bool, integer 0/1 and explicit true/false/yes/no/on/off/1/0 tokens; strict integers reject bool and truncating non-string numeric conversions; strict floats reject bool, NaN and Infinity. Strict lists accept string splitting or existing list/tuple values, apply mod once per item and report safe item positions on failure. Redact input values from strict conversion messages while retaining causes.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
